decisions.reason: As a consumer-facing superfood product with weaker website prominence and a faster-resolving market test than industrial equipment, it looks less core and less worth carrying versus other technology options.
This modular extension fits the firm's established waste-to-energy business, likely has low carrying cost, and its B2B potential is still too uncertain after one year to abandon.
A dedicated product page and strong alignment with the firm's established energy-from-waste capabilities suggest commitment, while the long industrial sales cycle keeps the option value high.
Although technically and commercially more uncertain than the core offers, plastic-to-fuel remains strategically close to the firm's sustainability platform and is still worth keeping as an option.
